The new modules hold exactly 13 and 4 constants, none private or auxiliary. labels.label: T-abs-hoist-plain-locz/ladder-edge
labels.notes: Elaborated signature: ∀ {M : Type u_1} [TopologicalSpace M] {C : Causal.Causality M}, C.PushUp → C.ChronalNeighbours → C.CausallyPlain. This is the target's push_up ∧ chronal_neighbours ⇒ causally_plain, with no standing axiom and no other premise. It uses the library's definitions exactly: PushUp and CausallyPlain (Causal/Properties.lean:69, :55) and ChronalNeighbours (Causal/LadderLocal.lean:163, ChronalPastNeighbours ∧ dual). Both premises are ladder properties (programme/ladder.toml:203 push_up = Causal.Causality.PushUp; :298 chronal_neighbours = Causal.Causality.ChronalNeighbours), and the conclusion is causally_plain (:233). The proof is the planner's: causallyPlain_of_locZ with S := ∅, LocZplus from hN.2 and LocZminus from hN.1 in W ⊓ interior N, lt_mono inf_le_left, interior_empty. Sharpness. (a) Dropping chronal neighbours fails at the lightlike line: Causal.deux_pushup gives lightlikeLine.PushUp ∧ ¬ lightlikeLine.CausallyPlain (DeuxPushup.lean:610-616), and lightlikeLine_not_chronalNeighbours is LadderLocal.lean:539. That is the ladder's existing [[fails]] push_up → causally_plain. (b) timelikeLineTop (Causal/Morphism.lean:708) is presented correctly as a probe, not a library fact: the docstring row says 'not in the library (T-abs-timelike-line-top)' and the REPORT says 'checked by a /tmp probe and are not in the library'. The three facts are true; I re-proved them in /tmp, kernel-checked and deleted. ChronalNeighbours is timelikeLine_chronalNeighbours by defeq. ¬PushUp holds by pushUp_iff with 1 ≪_ℝ 2 ≤_ℝ 0. ¬CausallyPlain holds because J⁺_ℝ({0}) = univ while closure I⁺_ℝ({0}) ⊆ Ici 0. 'Without gluing only' is right: timelikeLineTop_not_absolutelyMinimal is :754. Model corollaries, also re-probed in /tmp: (staticCausality X).CausallyPlain for [MetricSpace X] [GeodesicSpace X], (minkowski n), (massive α) and (cosmicString α) under [Fact (0 < α)] each follow in one line. No plainness of these models is in the strict library (grep). The simulated ladder (tmp copy of programme/ladder.toml with the proposed [[implies]]) gives 'ladder check' green, 23 implications.

findings.what: The ledger.py pitfall is right in substance but overstated in one respect. The REPORT says that 'the generated ledger would anchor it at the wrong declaration' and asks to 'confirm that each curated decl's anchor line is the intended declaration' / 'Check the anchor line'. But decl_line's line is never used: its only caller is check() (tools/ledger.py:1096), which tests `f is None` and discards `ln`. The ledger records no anchor line from it. The actual effect is that the existence check for Causal.Causality.BTZAxioms.K_neq_I passes vacuously against Causal.E0.K_neq_I (Causal/Port/E0ModelRows.lean:187). The fix applied since then, curation.toml:496 with "Causal/SingularFlatPlain.lean" appended after "Causal/Port/E0ModelRows.lean", does not change that, because files are scanned in list order. The check would also keep passing for that decl if SingularFlatPlain.lean were dropped from the row.
findings.fix: Word the kb pitfall as: 'ledger.py check resolves a curated decl by its last name component in the listed files, so a decl whose short name also occurs in an earlier listed file passes whether or not its own file is listed; after a hoist, grep the full declaration line (e.g. `theorem BTZAxioms.K_neq_I`) in the new file.' A real fix (matching the namespace-qualified name in decl_line) is a tools change outside this target.
